name: ID
description: A unique identifier for each soil or cacao leaf sample.

name: Lon
description: The geographic longitude of the sample location, measured in degrees.

name: Lat
description: The geographic latitude of the sample location, measured in degrees.

name: region
description: The specific region in Côte d'Ivoire where the sample was collected.

name: Clay
description: The percentage of clay content in the soil, indicating the proportion of soil particles with a diameter less than 0.002 mm.

name: C_org
description: The percentage of organic carbon in the soil, measured using the Walkley-Black method.

name: N_tot
description: The total nitrogen content in the soil, expressed as a percentage and determined by the Kjeldahl method.

name: P_avail
description: The available phosphorus content in the soil, measured in parts per million (ppm) using the Olsen, modified Dabin method.

name: K
description: The potassium content in the soil, measured in centimoles of charge per kilogram (cmol·kg-1) using the Metson method at pH 7.

name: Ca
description: The calcium content in the soil, measured in centimoles of charge per kilogram (cmol·kg-1) using the Metson method at pH 7.

name: Mg
description: The magnesium content in the soil, measured in centimoles of charge per kilogram (cmol·kg-1) using the Metson method at pH 7.

name: CEC
description: The cation exchange capacity of the soil, measured in centimoles of charge per kilogram (cmol·kg-1) using the Metson method at pH 7.

name: pH_water
description: The soil pH measured in a 1:2.5 soil-to-water ratio.

name: Satur
description: The percentage of soil saturation, indicating the proportion of soil pores filled with water.

name: C_N
description: The carbon-to-nitrogen (C:N) ratio in the soil, indicating the relative amounts of carbon and nitrogen present.

name: Fe
description: The iron content in the soil, measured in parts per million (ppm) using the EDTA method.

name: Mn
description: The manganese content in the soil, measured in parts per million (ppm) using the EDTA method.

name: Cu
description: The copper content in the soil, measured in parts per million (ppm) using the EDTA method.

name: Zn
description: The zinc content in the soil, measured in parts per million (ppm) using the EDTA method.

name: B
description: The boron content in the soil, measured in parts per million (ppm) using the hot water dilution method.
